bullets.content: [general] DOFs divide the score: a lean global h with local refinement beat uniform refinement on cost vs accuracy (bc0/bc7). On compression test h 0.0055-0.008 bulk with fine plastic-zone boxes before lowering h globally.
[general] Mesh is free, solves are not. An identical node count means the refinement was ignored: switch type (point→box) at once. Do not solve a mesh whose nodes change <2% vs the last solved one.

[general] Use >=5 of 6 nonlinear_checks, planned up front, one factor each. Write break-even before each: e < best product/nodes (12930/nodes on compression). Skip candidates whose break-even is below best e (~2.29%). Last check: twin of the best; gain <0.1 pt is noise.
[general] One factor per check: each check must differ from a checked mesh in exactly one refinement entry. Mesh 13 (columns+f37+right pockets) and mesh 17 (box+columns) were not attributable.

[general] Own gates are binding: if a candidate breaks the written node or q gate, rewrite the gate with a reason before checking, or linear-solve instead. a3 g8 checked 5530 nodes against a 5300 gate on a q 0.1103 branch and lost 1.07 pt.

[general] Never resubmit your previous generation's mesh or a near-control (a3 resubmitted again). Finish all 6 checks on structurally different targets (f5 box, f6 box, h change), submit the best NEW mesh within 1.11x of best e x nodes so diversity applies.

[general] Keep every written promise and gate. If a promise or gate becomes wrong mid-run, say so explicitly with the reason before breaking it (g6 broke view(error) and pocket-size promises). Don't spend checks on near-identical variants.

[general] After every solve, view(kind=error, iso) and list the top hotspots with local h. Check their coordinates against every box extent. A hotspot outside a box with h >1.4x the box size is the next target: add a box or group (points are no-ops).

[general] After the first linear solve always call view(error, z) and list hotspots whose local h is >1.3x the nearest box size (skipped in g7 despite the promise). Move or shrink the box accordingly.
[general] Point refinements are no-ops (bc0: 0.0018 and 0.0014 both gave 5661 nodes). Use boxes >=3x3x2.6 mm for local refinement and verify the node count changed.
[general] When best branch has q.min within 0.02 of the 0.1 gate, scan box edges ±0.0002 for a q>=0.2 twin at <=+1% nodes before submitting. q 0.11 branches checked 0.3-0.7 pt worse at equal nodes.

[general] When global h barely changes SE, treat h as a node-count knob: scan 4-5 h values with free mesh() and solve the minimum-node one (non-monotone). If a new box flips the mesher onto an expensive branch (+25-30% nodes), scan h ±0.0002-0.0005 before shrinking sizes (h 0.0082 restored 5.7k vs 7.2k at 0.008).

[general] Never change size/extent and h together in one experiment. If a new extent jumps the mesher branch, keep h and tweak the box by 0.0002. Attribute every nonlinear_check e change to exactly one factor.
[general] Never call compare with the same solve twice (compare(1,1) gave 0.0003). Compare different meshes and read which region carries the largest share of change.

[general] Never nonlinear_check two meshes within 1% nodes on the same branch with the same targets (5569 vs 5519 was a wasted check). Check only the cheapest twin; use the freed check on a different factor.
[general] Near-identical meshes differ 5-7% in compare(): that is the noise floor. Trust a change only if diff >7% and hotspot local h dropped where the error share was.

[general] Read the playbook's avoid notes before planning. A promise to skip a known-failing family (e.g. ring boxes) must survive mid-run temptation; log tempting hotspots in a known-failed region in your reflection instead of spending a solve.
[general] Two meshes differing ~1% in nodes are different meshes. Don't dismiss a cheaper scan as 'the same' when checks are spare; compute break-even (e < best product / nodes) and spend the check.
[general] Replacing groups with equivalent boxes changes the recipe and may earn diversity. When a peer uses groups, try boxes at the same places and check nodes and e hold.

[general] Diversity bonus needs structural difference (h >1.5x apart, another order, or mostly different targets). Control, h-variant and size-variant runs share targets and earn nothing; copying a peer's boxes with only h or sizes changed ties. Change WHERE you refine, announce before the first mesh; win on product.

[general] Diversity gate missed twice (0.650 vs 0.656, 0.703 vs 0.717). Before submitting compute base = 11510/(e% x nodes) and compare with 0.9x best known base; if below, a different recipe pays nothing extra: submit the higher-scoring mesh. If within ~5%, check its cheapest neighbour.
[general] Compare accuracy gain with DOF rise before every check. Test a lean variant early: on compression ~4-6k nodes; uniform 4 mm (9.5k nodes, 2.0%) is the cost ceiling to beat.
[general] quality.min must be >=0.1 on the submitted mesh. If a box makes it fail, shift the box edge by 0.0002 or h by 0.0005 and re-scan with free mesh() before any solve or check.

[general] The reference-free error estimate underestimated true error ~1.6x on field-scored tasks. On compression ignore it for scoring and use nonlinear_check e; use the estimate only to place refinement.
[general] A refinement box's node cost scales with volume/size^3. A 43x18x16 mm box at 2.2x finer than h added ~35% nodes. Size boxes to the 3-5 mm band where the hotspot is, not a whole half-region.
[general] When extrapolating e vs h, use peers' data before calling a curve flat. e was nonlinear in h (2.93% at 0.0047 vs 1.97% at 0.0042). Free-mesh the finer h and check one point first.

[general] Run the one-factor baseline check (same h, no new box) BEFORE variant checks: baseline, variant, repeat on a second branch. Keep the cheapest mesh with good e; re-issue the best logged mesh before the final solve.
[general] Diversity experiment: different h (e.g. 0.0065 with lean carrier 0.005), only if cost stays below 6500 nodes.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Best family: h 0.008, carrier [-0.031,-0.02,-0.0082,0.031,0.032,0.0082] 0.004 r0.004, mirrored pockets 0.0025, arms 0.0034, plus left-pocket 0.0023 r0.003: 5650 nodes, q 0.22, 2.29%, 12.9k. Baseline to beat. Don't move top edge of carrier.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Next mesh: h 0.008, order 2, carrier 0.004 r0.004; pockets [0.0205,0.0225,-0.0082,0.0265,0.0285,0.0082] and mirrored 0.0025 r0.004; arms [0.025..0.031 / mirrored, y 0..0.008] 0.0034 r0.004; left nested 0.0023 r0.003. Free-mesh first; accept nodes<5650, q>=0.1.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Control tweak: pocket top edge y 0.029->0.0285 (corner hotspots at y 25.2-25.8 stay covered). If branch jumps (>5750 nodes or q<0.1), try 0.0287 then 0.0283, then pocket y-min 0.0225->0.0228. One edge per mesh. Break-even e<12930/nodes.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Carrier coarsening is closed: 0.0048 gave 3.37% at 5530 vs 2.29% at 5650 (1.0 mm +6.6%, 2.0 mm +2.0%); 0.0045-0.0047 gave 5595-5934 nodes, no cheaper. Keep carrier 0.004.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Keep pockets 0.0025 (only size change that moved e: 2.30% vs 2.45%; 0.0024 gave 2.43%). Arms 0.0034 unchanged for attribution.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Nested left-only pocket 0.0023 inside 0.0025 (1.09x finer, asymmetric) gave 2.29% vs 2.30%, +38 nodes: noise. Don't add nested boxes <1.4x finer than host or one-sided boxes on this symmetric load.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Global h is dead: 0.0077/0.0079 gave 2.46/2.35% (13.5k/13.1k product); 0.0076, 0.00785, 0.0081-0.0085 jump to 6907-7811 nodes. Keep h 0.008; h is a0's factor, don't touch it.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Plan: 1 tweak (pocket y-max), 2 twins (edge ±0.0002), f5 box, outer-arm f6 box, 1 spare. Before a coarsening check, linear-solve both and compare(): large arm/bore change predicts failure.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] First linear solve = control mesh, then view(error, iso) and view(error, z), then compare(control, tweak) before any check. Write each hotspot's local h vs box size. Skipped in g7 and g8: must not happen a third time.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Diagnostic: carrier 0.0037 for the frozen +5.8% 1.0 mm point. If it drops >0.5 pt, stiffness error is in carrier volume, not pockets. Report whatever the product; submit only if e x nodes < best.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] 1.0 mm checkpoint sits at +5.6-5.9% on every mesh, flooring e near 2.3%. It responds to carrier size (5.65% at 0.004, 6.6% at 0.0048), not base, slab or h: use as stiffness gauge. Judge by 1.5/2.0/2.5 mm points too.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Untested WHERE target (also gives diversity): mirrored f5 bore-flank boxes [±0.011..±0.018, y -0.017..-0.010, full z] 0.003 (s1 48.3 MPa at x -14.2, y -13.6). Break-even e<12910/nodes.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Untested separate factor: box on outer arm f6 (x -29..-26, y 2..6 mm, full z) at 0.003. Add separately from the f5 box to attribute the effect.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Peer a1 g8: base-top slab [-0.031,-0.032,-0.0082,0.031,-0.02,0.0082] at 0.0055 gave 2.21% at 5981 nodes (13.22k); only target that lowered every checkpoint. a1's direction; don't copy.

[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Peak PEEQ hotspots at pocket/arm tops (x ±23.7, y 25.7, z ±6.6) and left round pocket. Try 0.0022-0.0024 only in a narrow r0.003 box at the hotspot with carrier unchanged; 1.0 mm checkpoint carries largest error.
[general] [abc_00000065_compression] Old CONTROL (0.916): h 0.008, carrier top 0.035 0.004, pockets 0.0025: 5754 nodes, q 0.108, 2.45%, 14.10k. Superseded by a1 g7 (12.91k).
